answer: A practical defence is Taxi licence with council background check records. It rests on a licence a council issued after its own checks, which gives every honest agent a knoll that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a licence a council issued after its own checks takes calendar time as well as money — and the nebula is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The anchor is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money.
